headline: Your Daily Learning Calendar—365 days of curiosity, growth, and discovery
universal_truth: Small daily investments compound into extraordinary transformation over time
fun_facts: Just 5-10 minutes of daily learning adds up to over 60 hours per year
Consistent learners retain 4x more than cramming learners
Daily micro-learning fits into any schedule—commute, coffee, or bedtime
discussion_questions: When in your day could you fit 5 minutes of learning?
What transformation would 365 days of daily learning create?
How would your life be different a year from now?

hook.script: Welcome to your daily learning calendar. 365 days. 365 lessons. 365 opportunities to grow. This isn't about cramming or stress—it's about small, consistent steps that compound into something extraordinary.

cliff.script: Here's the question: How do you actually make daily learning stick? Why do most learning habits fail while some transform lives?

options.text: Consistency beats intensity—small daily actions compound while occasional marathons fade; the calendar is designed for sustainable, enjoyable daily engagement
options.response: Exactly. Five minutes every day beats five hours once a month. The calendar is designed to be your companion, not your taskmaster. Show up daily, even briefly.

options.text: You need lots of free time
options.response: Actually, less is more. Each lesson is designed for 5-10 minutes. Fitting into busy lives is the whole point...

fact1.title: Two Tracks, One Journey
fact1.script: Your calendar has two tracks: LEARN and GROW. LEARN explores the world—science, philosophy, creativity. GROW builds your skills—AI fluency, meta-learning, personal development. Together, they create balanced growth.

fact2.title: Pick Up Where You Left Off
fact2.script: Missed a day? No problem. The calendar remembers where you were. Jump back in anytime. There's no falling behind—just continuing forward. Progress, not perfection.

fact3.title: Your Streak, Your Motivation
fact3.script: Watch your streak grow as you show up daily. Streaks aren't about pressure—they're about seeing your consistency visualized. Every day you learn is a day invested in yourself.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: The best time to start learning was years ago. The second best time is today. Your calendar is ready. Are you?

outro.script: That's your calendar introduction. Head to Day 1 to begin your journey, or explore the special lessons for more guidance. Welcome to a year of curiosity.

growTrack.title: Calendar Setup - Make It Yours
growTrack.learning_objective: Set up your learning calendar for success
growTrack.activity: Choose your daily learning time. Set a reminder. Tell someone about your commitment. These three steps dramatically increase follow-through.
